hardware_profile.training_cost: Low (Transfer learning on Colab T4: ~30-45 mins)

selected_model.selection_reason: BASELINE_A (current best_cer.pth CRNN warm-start) preserves 59.5k pretrained Vietnamese handwriting representations with stable convergence, negligible blank collapse risk, <10ms CPU/GPU inference latency, and verified transfer learning to unified math/Vietnamese vocabulary. Retained over heavy Transformer/TrOCR alternatives due to superior inference speed, low VRAM footprint on mobile edge/backend, and zero dependency issues.

benchmarked_alternatives.selection_reason: Significantly higher inference latency (>120ms per line on CPU), large memory footprint (>1.2GB parameters vs 23MB for CRNN), and requires autoregressive decoding which slows down real-time mobile worksheet processing. Retained BASELINE_A as primary production engine.
